source.content: public class CoreRuntimeLocalServiceScheduler implements Schedulable { public void execute(SchedulableContext sc) { insert new Account(Name = 'scheduled local service'); } }
public class CoreRuntimeLocalContinuationController { public String resume() { HttpResponse response = (HttpResponse)Continuation.getResponse('request-1'); return response.getBody(); } }

public class CoreRuntimeLocalSandboxCopy implements SandboxPostCopy { public void runApexClass(SandboxContext context) { System.assertEquals('00D000000000001', String.valueOf(context.organizationId())); System.assertEquals('0GR000000000001', String.valueOf(context.sandboxId())); System.assertEquals('preview', context.sandboxName()); } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeLocalQuickActionTest { @isTest static void runsLocalQuickActionDtos() { List<QuickAction.DescribeAvailableQuickActionResult> available = QuickAction.describeAvailableQuickActions('Account'); System.assertEquals(1, available.size()); System.assertEquals('Account.NewTask', available[0].getName()); List<QuickAction.DescribeQuickActionResult> described = QuickAction.describeQuickActions(new List<String>{'Account.NewTask'}); System.assertEquals(1, described.size()); System.assertEquals('Account', described[0].getTargetSobjectType()); QuickAction.QuickActionTemplateResult template = QuickAction.retrieveQuickActionTemplate('Account.NewTask', '001000000000001'); System.assertEquals(true, template.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('Account.NewTask', template.getDefaultValues().getQuickActionName()); List<QuickAction.QuickActionTemplateResult> templates = QuickAction.retrieveQuickActionTemplates(new List<String>{'Account.NewTask'}, '001000000000001'); System.assertEquals(1, templates.size()); QuickAction.QuickActionRequest request = new QuickAction.QuickActionRequest(); request.setQuickActionName('Account.NewTask'); request.setContextId('001000000000001'); QuickAction.QuickActionResult one = QuickAction.performQuickAction(request); System.assert(one.isSuccess()); QuickAction.QuickActionResult two = QuickAction.performQuickAction(request, true); System.assert(two.isSuccess()); List<QuickAction.QuickActionResult> listOne = QuickAction.performQuickActions(new List<QuickAction.QuickActionRequest>{request}); System.assertEquals(1, listOne.size()); List<QuickAction.QuickActionResult> listTwo = QuickAction.performQuickActions(new List<QuickAction.QuickActionRequest>{request}, true); System.assertEquals(1, listTwo.size()); QuickAction.SendEmailQuickActionDefaults defaults = Test.newSendEmailQuickActionDefaults('001000000000001', '00T000000000001'); System.assertEquals('SendEmail', defaults.getActionName()); System.assertEquals('SendEmail', defaults.getActionType()); System.assertEquals('001000000000001', defaults.getContextId()); System.assertEquals('00T000000000001', defaults.getInReplyToId()); System.assertEquals(0, defaults.getFromAddressList().size()); System.assertNotEquals(null, defaults.getTargetSObject()); defaults.setIgnoreTemplateSubject(true); defaults.setInsertTemplateBody(false); defaults.setTemplateId('00X000000000001'); } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeLocalQuickActionDefaultsHandlerTest { @isTest static void acceptsDefaultsListCallback() { QuickAction.QuickActionDefaultsHandler handler = new QuickAction.QuickActionDefaultsHandler(); List<QuickAction.QuickActionDefaults> defaults = new List<QuickAction.QuickActionDefaults>{new QuickAction.QuickActionDefaults()}; handler.onInitDefaults(defaults); System.assertEquals(1, defaults.size()); System.assertEquals(null, defaults[0].getActionName()); System.assertEquals(null, defaults[0].getActionType()); } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeLocalRequestSandboxTest { @isTest static void runsLocalRequestAndSandboxGetters() { Request request = Request.getCurrent(); System.assertEquals('glade-request-000000000001', request.getRequestId()); System.assertEquals('RUNTEST_SYNC', request.getQuiddity().name()); System.assertEquals('glade-request-000000000001', RequestImpl.getCurrent().getRequestId()); UIRequest uiRequest = UIRequest.getCurrent(); System.assertEquals('local.glade.example', uiRequest.getRequestHeader('host')); System.assertEquals('local.glade.example', uiRequest.getRequestHeader('Host')); System.assertEquals(null, uiRequest.getRequestHeader('x-missing')); Test.testSandboxPostCopyScript(new CoreRuntimeLocalSandboxCopy(), '00D000000000001', '0GR000000000001', 'preview', true); } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeLocalScheduleTest { @isTest static void drainsLocalSchedule() { Test.startTest(); String scheduleId = System.schedule('local service closeout', '0 0 0 * * ?', new CoreRuntimeLocalServiceScheduler()); Test.stopTest(); CronTrigger cron = [SELECT Id, State FROM CronTrigger WHERE Id = :scheduleId]; System.assertEquals('Complete', cron.State); System.assertEquals(1, [SELECT COUNT() FROM Account WHERE Name = 'scheduled local service']); } }

@isTest private class CoreRuntimeLocalHarnessTest { @isTest static void runsLocalHarnessHelpers() { Test.enableChangeDataCapture(); Continuation cont = new Continuation(60); cont.addHttpRequest(new HttpRequest()); cont.continuationMethod = 'resume'; HttpResponse response = new HttpResponse(); response.setBody('continued'); Test.setContinuationResponse('request-1', response); Object observed = Test.invokeContinuationMethod(new CoreRuntimeLocalContinuationController(), cont); System.assertEquals('continued', (String)observed); } }
